limitations: Images span 2018–2025; this is a coherent reconstruction, not a verified October 2026 inventory.
No photographs or extracted photograph textures published. Material maps are authored procedurally.
Kerb geometry, tile sizes, signal orientations, pole count and unrecorded furnishings are photographic estimates, typically 0.5–2 m placement uncertainty.
Tactile patches, access covers and drainage locations are interpreted where imagery cannot resolve exact layouts; do not treat as an accessibility or highway survey.
Perimeter beyond core forecourts/island remains approximate and is identified separately.
Extension heights/widths and tree positions are estimates, not a highway survey. London Street ends at Chapel/Hoghton; further station-side extension remains separate.
Fountain sculpture and bus shelter structures deferred pending adequate close references. Water and vegetation are schematic representations.
